picks.excerpt: Guillaume Broche, director of GOTY-sweeping RPG Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, told Konbini's Video Game Club that prompt-generated whole games are coming and 'everyone's a little scared.' Sandfall bars generative AI from creative work — it 'takes away from the joy of creating things' — allowing only case-by-case admin/coding use, after last year's placeholder AI-texture flap.

An 'AI Fiction in the Wild' paper presented at Purdue's MFS Cultural AI Conference mined 500k anonymized WildChat ChatGPT logs: over a third involved fiction generation, 2% of users produced 80% of it, and the most-requested game universes were Doki Doki Literature Club, League of Legends, and Freedom Planet — topped by one user generating thousands of DDLC birth fics. PC Gamer contrasts this solipsistic loop with communal human fanfic on AO3.

Kotaku found Amazon flooded with AI-generated 'strategy guides' — hallucinated chapters, AI covers, $20+ price tags — for unreleased games including Alien: Isolation 2, Control: Resonant, and Gears of War: E-Day, from prolific fake authors with dozens of listings. Amazon removed flagged books only for identical ones to reappear immediately.

An Agents of Young Performers Association open letter signed by 1,000+ performers accuses Hasbro of pressuring Peppa Pig child actors into contracts allowing AI use of their voices across all franchise commercial assets with no extra pay; Hasbro didn't deny being the letter's subject. PC Gamer frames it through Hasbro's game-IP empire (D&D, Magic: The Gathering).
